name: Youth Conservation Corps (Rocky Mountain Youth Corps)
what_you_do: Join a crew of 8 to 10 peers and two crew leaders for two or four weeks of trail building, restoration and work on invasive species and wildlife habitat. You camp together at night.
who_can_apply: Students in grades 6 to 12 in Northwest Colorado. Groups: Adventurers (6th and 7th), Trailblazers (8th and 9th), Outdoor Leaders (10th to 12th).
pay_detail: The page does not state pay. The Colorado Youth Corps Association lists the youth program as ages 14 to 18, so ask whether your group is paid.
deadline_text: Dates are not posted on the page.
how_to_apply: Contact the Youth Programs team: Kimberly Tholis (Director) or Shawn O'Kane (Manager). The page has a Reach Out link.
notes: More than 200 teens join each year. Based in Steamboat Springs. Parents have a policy page.
